185116.description:
The story of GNOSIA takes place on a ship drifting through space. Gnosia is an enemy that disguises itself as a human and attacks them. It is now on the spaceship, causing everyone onboard to be suspicious of each other. The crew decides to vote on the most suspicious-looking person every day and put them into a cold sleep.

If the humans succeed in putting Gnosia to sleep, they'll win. On the other hand, if they don't, everyone on board is in danger. The right decision must be made. No matter what decision is made by the main character, Yuri, she finds herself in a time loop that returns her to the first day of the crisis.

Will the crew on board make the right decision? What is the secret behind the time loop? What secrets hide behind the faces of everyone on board?

GNOSIA begins now – a story of looping, fleeting moments that feels like an eternity but passes by in an instant.

Have a pleasant journey.

Living in fear of death and destruction, people go about their daily lives as if trying to avert their eyes from danger and disaster.

After work, Mia lives a blissful life of drinking and playing online games! One day, while chatting with her online gaming friends as usual, she finds out that they recently broke up for the same reason: a lack of sex. The trust and closeness they've built up over being friends for years, along with years of sexual frustration, has her letting out a lot of information in the process, and she finally makes plans to meet up offline...

185727.description:
The legendary hacker was chased to death by the system's AI in order to save humanity, and unexpectedly became the leader of the first sect in another world. However, in order to deal with the situation of all undercover agents in the sect and the system crisis that came with it, Chen Ning just wanted to keep a low profile and wait and see, have a look. But like a cone in the bag, even though he was cold-faced and unparalleled and cared about the world, he was still among thousands of flowers, and each one was touched. Finally, with the help of the system agent Jiang Que, Chen Ning's domineering body shook, and both the enemy and ourselves just bow down and bow! The secrets of the world rushed to be opened to him, and he finally solved the crisis of annihilation.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: Everyone in the Sect Except Me is an Undercover Agent

185212.description:
The 28th Detective Conan movie.

When a researcher is attacked in the Yatsugatake Mountains, Nagano PD’s Kansuke Yamato and Yui Uehara investigate, but Kansuke’s old eye injury flares up — hinting at a dark connection. Meanwhile, Kogoro’s ex-colleague is murdered after looking into a past incident of Kansuke’s. Teaming up with Amuro and Kazami, Conan digs in to uncover the truth behind it all.

(Source: Sony Pictures Australia)
